query_name:
select  
    sum(ss_net_profit) as total_sum
   ,s_state
   ,s_county
   ,grouping(s_state)+grouping(s_county) as lochierarchy
   ,rank() over (
 	partition by grouping(s_state)+grouping(s_county),
 	case when grouping(s_county) = 0 then s_state end 
 	order by sum(ss_net_profit) desc) as rank_within_parent
 from
    store_sales
   ,date_dim       d1
   ,store
 where
    d1.d_month_seq between 1212 and 1212+11
 and d1.d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk
 and s_store_sk  = ss_store_sk
 and s_state in
             ( select s_state
               from  (select s_state as s_state,
 			    rank() over ( partition by s_state order by sum(ss_net_profit) desc) as ranking
                      from   store_sales, store, date_dim
                      where  d_month_seq between 1212 and 1212+11
 			    and d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk
 			    and s_store_sk  = ss_store_sk
                      group by s_state
                     ) tmp1 
               where ranking <= 5
             )
 group by rollup(s_state,s_county)
 order by
   lochierarchy desc
  ,case when lochierarchy = 0 then s_state end
  ,rank_within_parent
 limit 100;

Order By: rank() OVER (PARTITION BY (GROUPING(tpcds_sf8.main.store.s_state) + GROUPING(tpcds_sf8.main.store.s_county)), CASE  WHEN ((GROUPING(tpcds_sf8.main.store.s_county) = 0)) THEN (tpcds_sf8.main.store.s_state) ELSE NULL END ORDER BY sum(tpcds_sf8.main.store_sales.ss_net_profit) DESC) ASC

Projections: CASE  WHEN (((GROUPING(tpcds_sf8.main.store.s_state) + GROUPING(tpcds_sf8.main.store.s_county)) = 0)) THEN (s_state) ELSE NULL END
